description: MCP request/response latency for POST requests only. Long-lived GET /mcp SSE connections are excluded because their completion duration reflects connection lifetime and rolling restarts, not handler latency. Inspect moltnet-traces by route and correlate the time window with moltnet-logs.
mplQuery:
`moltnet-metrics`:`http.server.request.duration`
| where `service.name` == "moltnet-mcp-server" and `http.method` == "POST"
| bucket by `http.route` to 5m using interpolate_cumulative_histogram(rate, 0.95)
name: MoltNet MCP POST request latency p95 by route
